revised_claim_text: Latin America experiences severe cargo theft, with Mexico the world's highest-risk environment. Mexico: cargo theft every ~33 minutes (AMESIS, 2025); 15,937 incidents in 2024 (+9.15% YoY); 73% involve violence (BSI/TT Club April 2025 report); 81% violence rate Q1 2025 (AMESIS via Spanish-language logistics media). Brazil dominates South America (68% of regional thefts). [ASSUMED-N]: The $5.5B annual Latin America loss figure circulated as IUMI 2023 cannot be confirmed directly in IUMI publications — IUMI Feb 2026 press release characterizes losses as 'several billions of Euros' globally, without LatAm dollar breakdown. To validate: request IUMI statistics report directly.
